entries.title: Week10 provisional scoring and seven prospective expectation reviews
entries.question: Which archived revisions changed points, and which role/availability expectations actually held?
entries.why_it_matters: Separate evidence quality and opportunity from touchdowns, injury outcomes and retrospective explanations.
findings: All ten included main-slate games final; calculated final198.92 versus first complete159.02 and Claude original148.62.
Claude's Mumpfield-to-Dell factual correction lost6.00 while fixing the erroneous Week9 premise.
Johnson22 carries/seven targets supported lead role; Warren three targets/two catches for one yard challenged receiving expectations despite86%snaps.
Rice46%snaps and Dell49%snaps retain participation uncertainty; qualified routes unavailable.
Week6–9 already have complete provisional comparisons; bounded Week9 Seattle10 check matched, no material correction observed.
interpretation: Final gain does not establish improved reasoning or universal agent skill; selection changes share funding and evidence dependencies.
Lead work justified Johnson at cutoff; two receiving TDs were not predicted. Kelce injury confounds the realized swap delta.
Concepcion opportunity was supported, but a rushing TD drove most of his score advantage.
No invented pregame expectations; only seven bound IDs evaluated.
alternatives: Keep Kelce: final165.82 on same other eight; defensible pregame, injury-affected outcome.
Keep Allen: actual11.10 versus Dell5.10; changed team invalidated old role premise, not his main-slate existence.
uncertainty: Reconstructed scores are provisional, not platform settlement; stat corrections possible.
Missing routes/pressure attribution and in-game injury counterfactuals remain unassessable.
Original Claude self-estimate, clock/source corrections and restricted endorsement remain as recorded.
entries.lineup_effect: No selection changed. Original salaries/projections retained; all ten complete versions scored; one partial unassessable.
change_triggers: A verified material statistical/platform correction produces a new dated review with predecessor; never replace pregame records.
carry_forward: Test role applicability anew: lead carries supported Johnson but two receiving TDs are not a floor.
Preserve failed changes: Dell cost6 points versus Allen despite corrected information; do not prefer a correction only because it scored well.
Assess Warren team passing opportunity separately from snap share and vacated targets.
High game total did not guarantee Watkins's role; compare whole-lineup concentration once prices exist.

outcomes.expectation: Retain the leading Buffalo rushing role if active; do not expect another 31 carries or a receiving floor.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: 18 of32 team carries; next RB Davis3. Cook35 snaps (61%), one target, no catch. Leading rushing role persisted; a receiving floor did not.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Active; game script and Allen's two rushing TDs affected allocation.
outcomes.score_explanation: 157 rushing yards included a74-yard run; rushing TD and100-yard bonus produced24.70.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Retaining the rushing lead was supported at cutoff; efficiency and long-run outcome cannot validate a receiving-floor claim.

outcomes.expectation: Garrett continues participating after his verified return if available; current opponent QB/center/WR problems are conditions to recheck, not a turnover forecast.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Garrett17 defensive snaps (49%); McDuffie and Curl30 each (86%); all started. Qualified pressure counts unavailable.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Carson Beck started; Froholdt, Gaines and Jayden Williams inactive. Participation condition held, not a full-workload guarantee.
outcomes.score_explanation: Five sacks, two interceptions and six points allowed produced16.00; no defensive/return TD.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Conditional front/opponent assessment was defensible; causal contribution of each absence and pressure is unassessable.

outcomes.expectation: Continued meaningful receiving involvement is required to support the $6,100 selection; a Worthy absence is not assumed to increase Rice's routes.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Rice30 offensive snaps (46%), six targets,5-82. Receiving involvement remained, but routes unavailable and low participation remains a concern.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Mahomes played and threw five TDs; Rice caught none. No new injury explanation established.
outcomes.score_explanation: 13.20 from catches/yards; none of Mahomes's five TDs transferred to Rice.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Hold was conditional and plausible, but output does not resolve the retained route concern. Routes remain unassessable.

outcomes.expectation: Continue meaningful receiving participation in the outside rotation if active; no full-time role or repeat63-yard score expected.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Dell33 snaps (49%), four targets in38 team attempts,3-21; Hutchinson51 snaps (76%) and nine targets. Rotation persisted; routes/outside alignment unassessable.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Historical8-versus9 Week9 target conflict retained; neither full-time work nor another explosive score was promised.
outcomes.score_explanation: 5.10 versus Allen11.10: replacement lost6.00. Allen now SF31 snaps (48%), seven targets,5-61.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: A low-cost rotation case was reasonable after Allen trade, but the target-rate risk materialized. The correction did not deliver a point improvement.

outcomes.expectation: Remain a meaningful Colts receiving participant despite offensive personnel turnover; no guaranteed gain from departed WRs.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Warren51 snaps (86%) but three targets in22 attempts and2-1 receiving, plus one rush for3. Reduced absolute receiving opportunity challenged the premise.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Colts passing produced108 gross yards. Raimann left and was ruled out in-game; protection causality and routes remain unassessable.
outcomes.score_explanation: 2.40; high snaps and vacated receivers did not yield receiving production.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Original record explicitly warned targets need not transfer. Keeping Warren remained exposed to team-volume/protection risk; this miss is retained.

outcomes.expectation: Remain a meaningful Browns receiving participant with Watson starting, rather than needing a repeat64-yard touchdown.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Concepcion54 snaps (79%), eight targets in40 attempts,3-21; Boston58 snaps (85%), two targets,1-16. Both participated.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Watson started,312 gross passing yards, zero passing TDs; Boston was not absent.
outcomes.score_explanation: 11.70 includes6-yard rushing TD; receiving work alone5.10. Replacement gained9.10 versus Boston.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Receiving opportunity condition held, but the rushing TD—not a proven Watson receiving uplift—drove most of the point advantage.

outcomes.expectation: With Walker ruled out, Johnson is expected to receive meaningful lead rushing opportunity if active; no exclusive backfield or fixed touch floor assumed.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: Johnson22 of27 team carries,57 snaps (88%), seven targets and6-70. Carter two carries; Walker and Ott did not play.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Walker absence condition held. Ott nonparticipation is a postgame observation, not information retrospectively available at freeze.
outcomes.score_explanation: 101 rushing yards with bonus plus two receiving TDs produced38.10. Kelce5.00; swap+33.10. Kelce in-game injury/return and20 snaps (31%) confound comparison.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Lead-opportunity selection was supported by pre-cutoff team evidence and realized usage; exact workload/TDs were not forecast. One result does not prove universal RB-over-TE superiority.
